definitions.explanation: the worst possible result on a fortune slip drawn at a shrine or temple

examples.japanese: おみくじ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{大凶|だいきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いた→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: I drew the worst fortune on my omikuji.

examples.japanese: {大凶|だいきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{気|き}にしない→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧で⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Don't worry even if you get the worst fortune.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{大凶|だいきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いて→引く：01978_hiku⟧しまい、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{笑|わら}われた→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: I drew the worst fortune on New Year's and my friends laughed at me.

notes:
The lowest rank on the traditional fortune-telling slips ({御御籤|おみくじ}) drawn at Shinto shrines and Buddhist temples. The standard ranking from best to worst is: ⟦{大吉|だいきち}→大吉：19336_daikichi⟧ (great blessing), ⟦{吉|きち}→吉：19344_kichi⟧ (blessing), ⟦{中吉|ちゅうきち}→中吉：29072_chuukichi⟧ (moderate blessing), ⟦{小吉|しょうきち}→小吉：29073_shoukichi⟧ (small blessing), ⟦{末吉|すえきち}→末吉：29074_suekichi⟧ (future blessing), ⟦{凶|きょう}→凶：19345_kyou⟧ (misfortune), and {大凶|だいきょう} (great misfortune).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大凶|だいきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to draw the worst fortune
- {大凶|だいきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to get the worst fortune
- {大凶|だいきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧おみくじ: a worst-fortune slip

CULTURAL NOTE:
Drawing {大凶|だいきょう} is quite rare, as many shrines deliberately include very few in their selection. When drawn, it is customary to tie the slip to a designated rack or rope (⟦{結|むす}び→結び：02430_musubi⟧どころ) at the shrine, symbolically leaving the bad luck behind. Some people consider {大凶|だいきょう} to mean that things can only get better from this point.
